channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Thaddeus Young | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Thaddeus Young from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Rajakovic:

“I can speak about Thad Young all night …. we are lucky to have Thad as a veteran on our team”

Darko Rajakovic on Thaddeus Young, Jan 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Thad Young, who was a DNP-CD in each of the team’s final 14 games:

“It is (tough not to play him). Super class person. Super pro. Really got a lot of time for him... You always want guys to play more. That’s one of the hardest parts of the job.”

Nick Nurse on Thaddeus Young, Apr 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Fred VanVleet on the Thad Young-Dragic trade:

“Great piece, great addition, especially when the other guy was sitting at home so it wasn't like we were giving up much. That's the situation we were in so it's a +1 in my book. We'll take that.”

Fred VanVleet on Thaddeus Young, Feb 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Webster:

“We had made a few attempts to trade for Thaddeus in earlier years ....”

Bobby Webster on Thaddeus Young, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Vivek Jacob:Nick Nurse on Thad Young:

“My favourite thing is he's going to be versatile on the defensive end.”

Nick Nurse on Thaddeus Young, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Thad Young:

“He’s a pro. He knows how to play. He’s all about professionalism.”

Gregg Popovich on Thaddeus Young, Oct 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Thaddeus Young, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
McMillan told Kevin Bowen of 1070 The Fan.

“Thaddeus is our starting 4, and Sabonis is coming off the bench for us.”

Nate McMillan on Thaddeus Young, Domantas Sabonis, Nov 15, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Larry Bird on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Nate Taylor:Larry Bird on trade for Thaddeus Young:

“I wasn't really thrilled about this draft. We didn't feel very comfortable at the 20th pick.”

Larry Bird on Thaddeus Young, Jul 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
“We’ve got a good story to tell -- with the addition of our $50 million practice facility and the D-League franchise -- and I think we’ll be in a position where we’ll be able to add to Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Bojan Bogdanovic and some of the other younger pieces, and bring in the necessary pieces to turn things around quickly.”

Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Dec 19, 2015. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Billy King on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Billy King:

“No disrespect to Mirza, my main focus right now is Brook and Thaddeus because they’re two key pieces for us.”

Billy King on Thaddeus Young, May 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Earl Clark on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Fred Kerber:#Nets Lionel Hollins re: Earl Clark:

“We got him because Thaddeus is hurt& we wanted a more experienced guy...so he’s going to play.”

Earl Clark on Thaddeus Young, Mar 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @FredKerber.

item.title: Kevin Love on Thaddeus Young, Andrew Wiggins, Alexey Shved, Anthony Bennett
item.description:
said Timberwolves owner Glen Taylor.

“On the floor, Kevin has worked hard to make himself a great player in the NBA. He also made it a priority to give back to the community through his Coat Drive and numerous other charitable endeavors. He represented the state of Minnesota well during his time with us and we wish him nothing but the best in Cleveland. I also want to thank Luc and Alexey for their contributions to the team and wish them well in Philadelphia. I am truly excited to welcome Andrew Wiggins, Anthony Bennett and Thaddeus Young to our team. Adding these young players, along with our No. 1 pick from this year, Zach LaVine, to our existing squad gives us a solid nucleus for the future.”

Kevin Love on Thaddeus Young, Andrew Wiggins, Alexey Shved, Anthony Bennett, Aug 23, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jim Tanner on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
Agent Jim Tanner told HoopsHype Young has been drawing plenty of attention from several clubs in the CBA.

“I have been contacted by multiple teams in China expressing very serious interest in having Thaddeus Young play in their league this season,”

Jim Tanner on Thaddeus Young, Aug 30, 2011. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Thaddeus Young
item.description:
He’s not on the level of New Jersey’s 2012 target, Dwight Howard, but he’s the type of versatile forward the Nets are missing (and thought they were getting with Travis Outlaw).

“If (Young) didn’t have the type of year he’s had, I don’t think the (76ers) would be a playoff team,”

Avery Johnson on Thaddeus Young, Apr 2, 2011. Source: New York Daily News.
